=======================================
Reserved words after optional chaining
=======================================

a?.delete(b);
m?.class;
m?.a.delete(1);
m?.[0];
m?.(x);
A?.<B>();

---

(program
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        optional_chain: (optional_chain)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (arguments
        (identifier))))
  (expression_statement
    (member_expression
      object: (identifier)
      optional_chain: (optional_chain)
      property: (property_identifier)))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (member_expression
          object: (identifier)
          optional_chain: (optional_chain)
          property: (property_identifier))
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (arguments
        (number))))
  (expression_statement
    (subscript_expression
      object: (identifier)
      optional_chain: (optional_chain)
      index: (number)))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (arguments
        (identifier))))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      type_arguments: (type_arguments
        (type_identifier))
      arguments: (arguments))))

=======================================
Reserved words as property names in type queries
=======================================

type A = import('x').default;
type B = typeof Map.prototype.delete;
let c: typeof Promise.prototype.finally;

---

(program
  (type_alias_declaration
    name: (type_identifier)
    value: (member_expression
      object: (call_expression
        function: (import)
        arguments: (arguments
          (string
            (string_fragment))))
      property: (property_identifier)))
  (type_alias_declaration
    name: (type_identifier)
    value: (type_query
      (member_expression
        object: (member_expression
          object: (identifier)
          property: (property_identifier))
        property: (property_identifier))))
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      type: (type_annotation
        (type_query
          (member_expression
            object: (member_expression
              object: (identifier)
              property: (property_identifier))
            property: (property_identifier)))))))

=======================================
Reserved words as export and import names
=======================================

export { a as null, b as function, c as instanceof };
export { function, default } from "./x";
import { instanceof as x } from "./y";

---

(program
  (export_statement
    (export_clause
      (export_specifier
        name: (identifier)
        alias: (identifier))
      (export_specifier
        name: (identifier)
        alias: (identifier))
      (export_specifier
        name: (identifier)
        alias: (identifier))))
  (export_statement
    (export_clause
      (export_specifier
        name: (identifier))
      (export_specifier))
    source: (string
      (string_fragment)))
  (import_statement
    (import_clause
      (named_imports
        (import_specifier
          name: (identifier)
          alias: (identifier))))
    source: (string
      (string_fragment))))

=======================================
Of as a variable name
=======================================

for (var of;;) {}
var of = 1;

---

(program
  (for_statement
    initializer: (variable_declaration
      (variable_declarator
        name: (identifier)))
    condition: (empty_statement)
    body: (statement_block))
  (variable_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (number))))

=======================================
Super as an object in type queries
=======================================

interface M {
  [keys: typeof super.foo]: string;
}

---

(program
  (interface_declaration
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (interface_body
      (index_signature
        name: (identifier)
        index_type: (type_query
          (member_expression
            object: (super)
            property: (property_identifier)))
        type: (type_annotation
          (predefined_type))))))
